latestVersion.changelog:
Subtitle Generator Japanese — Initial Release

- Generate accurate Japanese subtitles automatically for video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB).
- Easily burn Japanese captions into your videos for quick, professional results — perfect for content creators and educators.
- Cloud-based workflow: no software install required, processing completes in 1–2 minutes for most clips.
- Automatic setup: anonymous token registration and secure session management included.
- Simple commands for upload, export, credits checking, timeline state, and more.
- Clear error handling, supported formats, and batch or iterative editing workflows.
